title: Is it time to change your thinking?
html:
There is a saying that, “If your best thinking got you to where you are, maybe you need to change your thinking.

This morning Mike Hosking talked about a company that has made recession a swear word and you have to put money into a ‘swear jar’ if you say it. Their thinking is that if you’re talking about the recession, you are not being productive or moving forward.

That, to me, is a great example of changing your thinking because, until they put that in place, everyone probably thought it was ok to talk about the recession constantly. It was their best thinking at the time, until it was pointed out that it wasn’t getting them anywhere.

Your thoughts do have an effect on you. I was woken up at 4.30am by a dream (or nightmare) during which I was in a coffin, being buried alive. From then, I couldn’t close my eyes without thinking about being buried. However, I also kept coming up with ways to get out, lots of ways.

For me, apart from scaring the hell out of me, this opened my eyes to how I could grow my business. Amazing what a good scare will do to your mind.

Have a terrific week and maybe put a recession ‘swear jar’ in your office?
